ambient_trade.text: grain and dyed cloth going cheap in {town} this week. good time to buy, bad time to sell. ask me how i know
buying hides and wool in {town} at {gold} a bundle. paying fair, won't insult you with less
selling dyed cloth at {gold} a bolt. wholesale only, my mules have opinions about retail
{town} road tolls up again. that's {gold} off every load before the mules even stand up
anyone hauling iron south of {town}? i pay {gold} a cart and the first one gets a discount

encounter_trade_offer.text: i don't want a fight ser {player}. i want {gold} for the cloth you're carrying and you walk away with your teeth. fair price
one more step and my mules get braver than you. {gold} for safe passage to {town}, or we both lose coin today
{player}, i'll give you {gold} for your load at {town}. not a copper more, but i'll throw in a jug of ale
the numbers work for both of us, {player}. {gold} now beats a broken wagon on the {town} road
ser {player}, for you it's {gold}, and the road to {town} stays open for your carts. same deal as last time, only cheaper

encounter_greeting.text: {persona} of {my_faction}. you're standing on my road, {player}. state your business before my mules get bored
good day {player}, {persona} of {my_faction} here. carrying anything worth my time, or are we just passing in the wind
{player}! {persona} of {my_faction} here. what are you hauling this season? i'm short on salt and long on gossip
the mules have seen worse than you, {player}. {persona} of {my_faction}, at your service if the price is right

player_raided_my_village.text: {player} burned {village} and called it business. i remember every torch. some of us keep ledgers
ser {player}, burning {village} cost you more than it earned. nobody on the roads will sell to you now
{village} is ash now and the carts that used to pass it are going around. {player} can explain that to the guilds
{player}, a word in private. {village} was a good stop for my caravans. make it right and we can talk prices

war_declared.text: {my_faction} and {enemy_faction} are at war. every road between them just got twice as dangerous and half as profitable
war with {enemy_faction}? wonderful. grain prices will climb and my mules will complain about the detours
so {my_faction} went to war with {enemy_faction}. i'll be buying salt for twice what it was last week, mark me

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} made peace. finally the roads are safe enough to carry cloth without a sword in my back
peace between {my_faction} and {faction}. good for business, bad for the bandits who lived off the war
{faction} signed with {my_faction} at last. toll rates should drop by spring, or i'll complain loudly

released_by_player.text: {player} let me walk instead of ransoming me. generous, or just bad at math. either way i owe you a drink
ser {player}, i won't forget you let me go without a ransom. when salt prices drop, you get first pick
{player} released me. no ransom, no hard feelings, though i'm still writing the lost coin in my ledger
{player}, you let me go without the ransom. i'll pay it back in cloth, or in whatever you find useful
{player} released me for free. i'm not grateful, i'm just counting the coins i didn't lose

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat {troop_count} of my men and took the cargo. the mules got away, which is the only good business i did today
{player}, you beat {troop_count} of my men. fine. but a dead caravan sells nothing, so let's talk terms before the next one
well fought ser {player}. {troop_count} of my lads went down and i'm still counting the cost. we'll settle it over ale
{player} got past {troop_count} of my guards. cost me the day's profit, but i don't hold grudges, only ledgers
{player}, your {troop_count} held the field today. i'll be back with better guards and cheaper mules, mark it

whisper_beg_help.text: ser {player}, {enemy_faction} is pressing {fief}. i'll pay for your help in salt and a discount on road tolls
{player}, you're my best customer. {fief} is under threat from {enemy_faction} and i'm losing the ledgers. can you hold the road?
a word in private, {player}. {enemy_faction} has {fief} in a corner. help me hold it and i'll owe you a real favor
{fief} may fall to {enemy_faction} if no one moves, my friend. i'd rather not lose the market. please come
{player}, i'm not proud of this. {enemy_faction} is at {fief}'s gates. name your price and i'll consider it

ambient_complaint.text: bandits on the {town} road again. they took two bales and a mule. i'll remember both names
{rival} still hasn't paid me back for the horse. my mules remember, and so do i
tolls at {town} went up again. {faction} calls it upkeep. i call it highway robbery with paperwork
salt in {town} doubled overnight. someone's cornering the market and i'd love to know who
{rival} undercut my cloth at {town} and called it fair competition. it was not fair, it was spite

ambient_chatter.text: rain on the {town} road again. the mules are sulking and my boots have given up completely
anyone know if the {village} bridge is open? i'd rather not learn how deep it is with a loaded wagon
fine weather for hauling, which means every bandit in the hills is out too. stay sharp on the road
{village} bakes the best bread on this road. i'll trade cloth for loaves, just don't tell the mules
lag on the {town} route again. my mule train is fine, my patience is not
